title: Iran's President Insists Khamenei Is in 'Perfect Health,' Contradicting International Reports
detail: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian publicly stated that Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is in 'perfect health,' directly pushing back against international reports — including Israeli media claims and a Trump assertion that Khamenei was '90 percent gone' — of critical or deteriorating illness. The statement follows a week of conflicting signals: Iran released an undated 'proof of life' video of Khamenei meeting advisers, yet Pezeshkian himself had previously acknowledged that communication with the Supreme Leader was 'very difficult.' The fresh denial underscores the information war surrounding Khamenei's condition and Tehran's efforts to project regime stability amid the ongoing economic crisis and naval blockade.

media.caption: Iran's president says Khamenei is in perfect health
